from machine import Pin
import time

DIGITS = [0x3F, 0x06, 0x5B, 0x4F, 0x66, 0x6D, 0x7D, 0x07, 0x7F, 0x6F]


class TM1637:
    def __init__(self, clk, dio, brightness=7):
        self.clk = Pin(clk, Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.dio = Pin(dio, Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.brightness = brightness
        self._cmd(0x40)  # data command: write, auto-increment address
        self._cmd(0x88 | brightness)  # display on

    def _start(self):
        self.dio(0)
        time.sleep_us(2)
        self.clk(0)

    def _stop(self):
        self.dio(0)
        self.clk(1)
        time.sleep_us(2)
        self.dio(1)

    def _byte(self, b):
        for i in range(8):
            self.clk(0)
            self.dio((b >> i) & 1)
            time.sleep_us(2)
            self.clk(1)
            time.sleep_us(2)
        self.clk(0)  # ninth clock: the TM1637 acknowledges
        self.dio(1)
        self.clk(1)
        time.sleep_us(2)
        self.clk(0)

    def _cmd(self, c):
        self._start()
        self._byte(c)
        self._stop()

    def write(self, segs, pos=0):
        self._cmd(0x40)
        self._start()
        self._byte(0xC0 | pos)
        for s in segs:
            self._byte(s)
        self._stop()
        self._cmd(0x88 | self.brightness)

    def number(self, n):
        s = '%4d' % n
        self.write([0 if c == ' ' else (0x40 if c == '-' else DIGITS[int(c)]) for c in s[-4:]])
